title: Rule builder-test-edit lets a builder read a test file with grep
why: A builder may read tests but not edit them; a refused read-only grep costs a round and teaches the reader to scroll past the guard.
note: Filed 09:28 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 09:21 CST, from lane message-time-matches-clock, session_013NEJL1PfmnFVDD3X2P28Kk): the rule refused a builder's read-only grep of hooks/test_guard.py. Red case first: that grep, allowed. Its own lane at round 1; lane builder-probe-false-alarm (#1979) declined it at 09:27 CST.
